scientific_integrity: Stationary closure/fold theory and earlier size-structured and renewal-stability results credited to prior literature; finite computations check algebra only; novelty risk from inaccessible and unindexed special cases retained.
scientific_limitations: Sharp spectral linearization for constant hazard per size increment, no harvesting, constant environmental weight, positive C2 abundance-dependent speed and fixed boundary recruitment; no nonlinear global attraction or other vital-rate functions are claimed.
title: A sharp dynamical stability criterion for finite-size fixed-flux populations
